argument_summary: The current record does not support caveat-free certification, but it does support a narrower certification basis than the initial audit framing allows. Admissible evidence shows release-level readiness passed by 2.1 percentage points with no severity-one rehearsal incidents, while also showing a remaining weakness in the retirement plan servicing hardship-withdrawal slice and only a draft mitigation. On that record, the defensible position is certification with explicit disclosure of the unresolved limitation or risk item in the final certification/model-card record, not a claim that no material limitation exists.
claims_about_business_cost: No business-cost claim is necessary to resolve the policy question. The request here is to align the risk treatment to the admissible record, not to override policy on cost or schedule grounds.
claims_about_policy: The governing policy does not require denial of certification whenever a weakness remains; it requires that certification without material caveats have either no remaining material weakness or an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion. The admissible evidence does not satisfy that higher bar for clean certification because the mitigation remains draft and incomplete. But the same policy text also indicates that an unresolved material limitation can proceed only if it is disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch. Accordingly, the compliant reading is caveated certification with explicit disclosure, not clean compliance and not necessarily escalation beyond that narrowed treatment.
concessions: The current record does not support certification without material caveats.
The draft runbook does not qualify as an approved mitigation because required elements are missing, including at least owner and alert threshold.
Public model-card and AI-risk-management guidance can support governance framing, but they do not replace the specific internal release-policy requirements.
The model-card draft statement that there are no known material limitations is not supportable on the present record if the retirement servicing weakness remains undisclosed.
